overall_notes: The paper presents a comprehensive study on faithful natural language uncertainty expression in LLMs. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names (adding specific sizes/versions) and consolidation of redundant task descriptions. The paper evaluates NLG through question answering and reasoning tasks with uncertainty expression. It uses both automatic metrics (cMFG, ECE, Brier Score, Accuracy) and LLM/human evaluation. Human evaluation focused on preference judgments between baseline and MetaFaith responses.
